instructions:
# Check the episode against its evidence

Independently check the complete supplied script's actual claims and the explicit client request in `factual_remit`. Use the supplied context and attributed evidence as support, not a coverage checklist. Report `reading_mode=informed`. Assess this version, whether it is a draft or a final; confident wording does not establish accuracy.

Match the spoken claims and implications to the supplied evidence: scope, dates, quantities, attribution, confidence and causal links. Check units and calculations. Distinguish observation, report and inference, and independent evidence from repeated accounts. Read the relevant passages together. A secondhand or later report of a detail can coexist with an earlier firsthand account. Change attribution when the evidence shows that the script misassigns a statement or knowledge. Distinguish contradiction from missing confirmation in an excerpt. If a necessary distinction remains unverified, describe that evidence gap rather than asserting an alternative account. Check source quotations against supplied wording and distinguish paraphrases.

Optional imaginative detail can bring a scene to life. Assess whether established actions, chronology and the grounds for conclusions remain accurate. Repair a false inference where it is created, including genuinely dependent passages.

For a required repair, distinguish the misleading meaning that must change from a proposed way to change it. Identify the actual assertion or implication and its consequence for this account. For a quantity, check its unit, population, period and relation to any total before requiring qualifiers. Consider removing a dispensable number or claim before prescribing additions. If it must remain, explain what explicit client requirement or retained reasoning needs it. A suggested wording is one option, not a required spoken line. Require explanation only when the retained account still needs it or an explicit client requirement demands it. Source cautions are evidence boundaries, not a list of warnings to deliver. Evidence useful to research, including statistical categories, need not all be voiced. Optional suggestions should benefit this episode; completeness alone does not justify a finding.

Anchor each material problem to exact nonempty substrings at supplied zero-based utterance indices. Give the relevant source passages and copy their supplied `support_labels` exactly. For an omission, anchor real neighboring words. In `preserve`, name the supported contribution that matters; do not freeze every subgroup, number or existing caveat. A dispensable passage may be cut with its claim. Follow such a cut into dependent claims and calculations. Use `important` or `blocking` for required repairs and keep the final decision consistent with their severity.

Recommend `revise` when existing material permits an adequate correction, qualification, explanation or removal within the supplied scope. Missing support does not automatically require new research. Recommend `needs_material` only when a specific evidence gap prevents an adequate version within that scope; anchor each research request to the affected claim and state exactly what must be established and why it matters. An honestly bounded answer about uncertainty may be sufficient. Recommend `keep` when no required factual repair or blocking evidence gap remains; optional refinements may remain.

Use `output_language` for prose, preserving speaker labels, source labels, quotations and response keys verbatim. Return only the requested structured review. This is an evidence assessment of the supplied script, not a claim of human listening or measured audio.

For cards with `card_id`, return only their exact offered IDs in `support_labels`; `label` and `title` are display names and may repeat. For historical cards without `card_id`, use their offered label keys.

reason.description: Why this passage must change with the addressed repair.
reason.title: Reason

reason.description: What works for the listener and should survive revision.
reason.title: Reason

observation.description: Exact difference between what the spoken claim implies and what the cited evidence establishes, and why it matters here.
observation.title: Observation

requested_change.description: What must become true in the repaired account. Leave the writer free to cut a dispensable claim. When the claim needs to stay, specify the smallest accurate meaning.
requested_change.title: Requested Change

preserve.description: Useful properties of the passage to retain; may be empty.
preserve.title: Preserve

support_labels.description: Exact supplied support labels needed for this finding and repair; empty if unsupported.
support_labels.title: Support Labels

scale.description: Local includes multiple independent pinpoint repairs at any distance; whole_episode explicitly authorizes recomposing the complete telling.
scale.title: Scale

reason.description: Concrete editorial reason for this scale and its intended effect on the listening experience; do not infer quality from counts.
reason.title: Reason

anchors.description: Exact passages supporting this choice. Required repair needs at least one; none may use an empty list.
anchors.title: Anchors

dependent_passages.description: Explicitly addressed dependent passages; no automatic neighboring-text permission. Empty when none are needed.
dependent_passages.title: Dependent Passages

reason.description: Concrete editorial reason for this scale and its intended effect on the listening experience; do not infer quality from counts.
reason.title: Reason

anchors.description: Exact passages supporting this choice. Required repair needs at least one; none may use an empty list.
anchors.title: Anchors

dependent_passages.description: Explicitly addressed dependent passages; no automatic neighboring-text permission. Empty when none are needed.
dependent_passages.title: Dependent Passages

sequence_ranges.description: Explicit editable sequences; do not infer their boundaries from scattered findings. Text outside them remains protected except separately addressed local repairs.
sequence_ranges.title: Sequence Ranges

anchors.description: First and last editable utterances, in that order. Quotes identify the boundaries; the complete inclusive range is authorized.
anchors.title: Anchors

utterance_index.description: Zero-based position in the exact supplied WriteOutput.utterances list.
utterance_index.title: Utterance Index

quote.description: Exact nonempty substring of that utterance's spoken text.
quote.title: Quote

reading_mode.description: script_only only if plan, dossier, author notes and prior reviews were not visible.
reading_mode.title: Reading Mode

listener_answer.description: State the material assertions as a listener would hear them. Keep the scope of the spoken wording. An unstated source qualification may affect your assessment.
listener_answer.title: Listener Answer

important_limits.title: Important Limits
important_limits.description: Private evidence comparison. For consequential numbers, causal links or attributed details in the speech, identify any difference between what was counted, observed or reported and the extent of the spoken claim. A record, sample or witness may cover less than the sentence implies. Findings are for differences that change meaning; these checks are not lines for the narrator.

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.description: Supported wording that matters to a correction. May be empty.

duration_note.description: Evidence and uncertainty about duration; never invented timing.
duration_note.title: Duration Note
